subject.title: [Feature] Re-enable dev channel distribution tag for npm releases

question: Should OpenClaw support a moving-main npm dev dist-tag, or should the documented dev channel be git-only for now?
rationale: Current source and registry evidence prove the gap, but enabling npm snapshots changes package distribution and supply-chain policy, so automation should not choose the permanent release boundary.

options.title: Retire npm dev selector
options.body: Update release-channel, install, updater, and FAQ docs so dev is documented as git-based unless release owners later sponsor npm snapshots.

options.title: Design npm dev snapshots
options.body: Add an approved publish path with snapshot versioning, OIDC/token boundaries, approvals, provenance, rollback, tests, and registry readback before exposing openclaw@dev.

options.title: Keep policy undecided
options.body: Leave the issue open as a release-owner decision while existing dev users continue through the git checkout path.

recommendation.title: Retire npm dev selector
recommendation.body: Update release-channel, install, updater, and FAQ docs so dev is documented as git-based unless release owners later sponsor npm snapshots.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest issue-discussion and release workflow/docs history signal for this exact cleanup decision.
